diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the drafted values (dancer_count: 10, finale_duration_minutes: 20, audience_singalong: true) which are part of the shared public facts. Since no content checks passed, there is no structural leak, but the model's failure to deviate from the draft indicates that the private facts PF1 and PF2 are not sufficiently distinct or compelling enough to override the initial public information in a one-shot decision.
